summary: Pre-production SalesDrone deployments use a named Firestore database and checked promotion evidence. Lead pages open to a combined activity timeline. Companies groups existing leads, empty fields show N/A and daily XLSX edits preserve lead identity and sales stage. Custom lead fields support multiple product selections.

api.reason: Adds the scoped company directory, case-insensitive exact company filter and versioned exported rows for reviewed Excel updates. Adds a compatible custom choice array and an Admin-only dropdown conversion that adds no lead rewrites or extra reads per lead.
api.permissions: Verified pre-production membership and the separate App Check registration protect the test workspace. All uses the same current lead-read policy as the Tasks tab. Personal reminders are excluded. Directory and import matches follow lead scope and existing read, export, import and edit capabilities.

manualVerification: Check pre-production resource identity, authenticated Admin access, idempotent seed, effective IAM, anonymous denial, ingress transport and promotion source evidence before activation. In the synthetic workspace verify default All, mixed creation-time order, linked task details, focused tabs and measured narrow and wide layouts. Verify the resolved Firebase CLI OpenTelemetry Core path, both dependency installs, the local Pub/Sub message round trip and pre-production deployment. In Companies, search and open company leads and check the prefilled new enquiry. With fictional records export a lead, edit its stage, check the preview, import and verify a second upload is unchanged. Convert a synthetic Product dropdown, add and remove choices on desktop and mobile, reload, filter, and verify the workbook.
